provenance: Isolated v48 geometric-normal r3 calibration revision derived from frozen r2 source; exact near runtime/atlas preserved; all six source tiles calibrated; no reference-game imagery.
pngEncoding: raw straight RGBA8 PNG; filter0; zlib; zero-alpha RGB preserved
normalEncoding: octahedral bake-view normal RG; leaf identity B; resolved sample coverage A; linear data
albedoEncoding: unlit source albedo in sRGB plus resolved sample coverage; no fixed sun/fog
coverageEncoding: independent raw RGB=1 sample-occupancy pass; output alpha=c, RGB=resolved RGB/c; GL rows flipped once into PNG
limitations: No atlas has been visually accepted by generation alone.
128px tiles and four azimuths require fixed-view and moving-transition comparison.
Alpha remains unchanged; four-pixel tile-local RGB/normal/identity dilation protects mip1/bilinear silhouettes. Runtime must clamp to each frame and cap mip footprint.
Owner-run native alpha-ramp/normal/PNG-edge calibration remains required; source math alone does not establish pixel acceptance.
